cards.name: Spatial Contortion
cards.oracleText:
({C} represents colorless mana.)
Target creature gets +3/-3 until end of turn.

cards.name: Spatial Merging
cards.oracleText: When you encounter Spatial Merging, reveal cards from the top of your planar deck until you reveal two plane cards. Simultaneously planeswalk to both of them. Put all other cards revealed this way on the bottom of your planar deck in any order.

cards.name: Spatial Binding
cards.oracleText: Pay 1 life: Until your next upkeep, target permanent can't phase out.

cards.name: Spatula of the Ages
cards.oracleText: {4}, {T}, Sacrifice this artifact: You may put a silver-bordered or acorn permanent card from your hand onto the battlefield.
